name: Grace Miller
headline: Christian singer-songwriter from Jacksonville, FL
intro: Songs of faith, family and the long roads in between. The new album Quiet Harbor is out now.
story:
Raised on front-porch harmonies and Sunday hymns, Grace Miller writes songs about faith, family and the quiet places where hope grows.

She has led worship in small churches across the Southeast for ten years, and she still believes the best songs are the ones a congregation can sing back on the first try.
quote: A voice that sounds like it has lived every word it sings.
verse: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
